# Apple Mac Studio (2025) — Compact Pro Desktop (M4 Max / M3 Ultra)

**Category:** Desktop computer

**MSRP:** Starting at $1,999 (M4 Max)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Chip — M4 Max (base) | 14-core CPU (10P+4E), 32-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, 410GB/s memory bandwidth |
| Chip — M4 Max (configurable) | 16-core CPU, 40-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, 546GB/s memory bandwidth |
| Chip — M3 Ultra (base) | 28-core CPU (20P+8E), 60-core GPU, 32-core Neural Engine, 819GB/s memory bandwidth |
| Chip — M3 Ultra (configurable) | 32-core CPU, 80-core GPU, 32-core Neural Engine, 819GB/s memory bandwidth |
| Ray Tracing | Hardware-accelerated (both chips) |
| Media Engine (M4 Max) | H.264/HEVC/ProRes/ProRes RAW hardware accel, 1 video decode + 2 video encode + 2 ProRes encode/decode engines, AV1 decode |
| Media Engine (M3 Ultra) | H.264/HEVC/ProRes/ProRes RAW hardware accel, 2 video decode + 4 video encode + 4 ProRes encode/decode engines, AV1 decode |
| Memory — M4 Max | 36GB unified (base); configurable to 48GB, 64GB, or 128GB (16-core CPU/40-core GPU config only) |
| Memory — M3 Ultra | 96GB unified (base); configurable to 256GB |
| Storage — M4 Max | 512GB SSD; configurable to 1TB, 2TB, 4TB, or 8TB |
| Storage — M3 Ultra | 1TB SSD; configurable to 2TB, 4TB, 8TB, or 16TB |
| Display Support (M4 Max) | Up to 5 displays: 4x 6K@60Hz over Thunderbolt + 1x 4K@144Hz over HDMI, or 2x 6K@60Hz + 1x 8K@60Hz/4K@240Hz |
| Display Support (M3 Ultra) | Up to 8 displays: 8x 6K@60Hz/4K@144Hz, or 4x 8K@60Hz/4K@240Hz |
| Ports | 4x Thunderbolt 5 (up to 120Gb/s, USB4, USB 3 up to 10Gb/s, DisplayPort 2.1), 2x USB-A (up to 5Gb/s), 1x HDMI 2.1, 10Gb Ethernet, 3.5mm headphone jack |
| Front Ports (M4 Max) | 2x USB-C (up to 10Gb/s), SDXC card slot (UHS-II) |
| Front Ports (M3 Ultra) | 2x Thunderbolt 5 (up to 120Gb/s), SDXC card slot (UHS-II) |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) |
| Bluetooth | Bluetooth 5.3 |
| Ethernet | 10Gb (Nbase-T, supports 1/2.5/5/10Gb via RJ-45) |
| Audio | Built-in speaker; 3.5mm headphone jack with high-impedance headphone support; HDMI multichannel audio |
| Dimensions | 3.7" H x 7.7" W x 7.7" D (9.5 x 19.7 x 19.7 cm) |
| Weight | 6.1 lb (2.74 kg) M4 Max; 8.0 lb (3.64 kg) M3 Ultra |
| Max Continuous Power | 480W |
| Operating Temperature | 50° to 95° F (10° to 35° C) |
| Operating System | macOS |

## Notable Features

- Choice of two Apple silicon tiers in one chassis: M4 Max for high single/multi-thread performance, or M3 Ultra for maximum core count, GPU, and memory bandwidth
- Up to 256GB of unified memory (M3 Ultra) makes it well suited for large local LLM inference, video workflows, and other memory-bandwidth-bound tasks
- Four Thunderbolt 5 ports delivering up to 120Gb/s each, plus native DisplayPort 2.1 output
- Compact 7.7" square enclosure designed to sit under a display, with a quiet thermal system even under sustained load
- Extensive display output — up to 8 displays simultaneously on the M3 Ultra configuration
- Built largely from recycled materials (aluminum enclosure, copper, gold, rare earth elements) as part of Apple's environmental program
